method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading; exact structural comparison; and clause-by-clause replay of the abstract-logic, normality and expressive-power definitions. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Abstract logics, model classes, L-elementary equivalence, seven normality properties and expressive comparison.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: An abstract logic assigns each language a set of sentences and supplies a satisfaction relation between structures and those sentences. Its sentences need not have ordinary first-order syntax. Mod_L(E) is the class of structures satisfying E, and L-elementary equivalence means agreement on every L-sentence.
samples.checks: The language index, sentence set, satisfaction relation, infinite syntax examples, E/F versus A/B metavariable convention and model-class equality are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A normal abstract logic is monotone under language extension, depends on finitely many vocabulary symbols per sentence, is invariant under isomorphism and renaming, is closed under Boolean operations and quantification, and admits relativization to a predicate-defined subdomain.
samples.checks: All seven clauses retain their quantifiers, language inclusions, reduct dependence, model-class equations, arities, expansions and domain set-builder. OLFOL-045 corrects only the correspondence object in the renaming prose.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: L2 is at least as expressive as L1 when every L1-sentence has an L2-sentence with the same model class in each vocabulary; equivalence requires both directions. Ordinary first-order logic is normal and embeds into every normal logic by induction on formulas.
samples.checks: The direction of the expressive preorder, equality of model classes, two-way equivalence, first-order relativization recipe and no-loss-of-generality conclusion are preserved.

source_observations: MR-P136 directly attests अमूर्त; T296 records the definition-controlled compound अमूर्त तर्कशास्त्र.
T298 keeps all property names provisional while the displayed clauses control their exact meanings.
OLFOL-045 records that the renamed structure corresponds to M, not to the language L.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact normal-logic property names and अभिव्यक्तिक्षम remain expert-reviewable.
The source's label Expansion Property is translated as विस्तार गुणधर्म without asserting that this is the only established name for finite vocabulary dependence.
No TeX reader build was run for this source-only unit checkpoint.
